locus: Canon Missae, Memento for the living; Wilson printed p. 2, PDF p. 60, R fol. 4; complete main-text prayer from Memento through uero immediately before Communicantes
rights_basis: The identified Wilson 1915 printing is public domain in the United States by expiration of its publication term, as recorded for the parent facsimile and OCR artifacts. This bounded faithful transcription of its Latin main text adds no new authorship. It does not reproduce a modern critical edition or translation and is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0 license.
text: Memento domine famulorum famularumque tuarum. et omnium circum adstantium quorum tibi fides cognita est et nota deuotio qui tibi offerunt hoc sacrificium laudis pro se suisque omnibus pro redemptione animarum suarum pro spe salutis et incolomitatis suae tibi reddunt uota sua aeterno deo uiuo et uero.
